items.description: Progress badges and mosaic labels: README Progress section shows two per-EXE shields (UFO2P.EXE, TACP.EXE; tools/progress.py writes one shields.io endpoint JSON per EXE, combined progress-shield.json stays published) and progress.svg draws a label on each large unit (game unit = unit name, library unit = its largest runtime function name; no label on small squares; deterministic bytes; tooltips kept). Brief: .superpowers/sdd/let-s-work-on-phase-effervescent-nebula/progress-visuals-brief.md. TDD.

Progress page: new progress.html written by tools/progress.py and published by .github/workflows/pages.yml, linked from the README; per-EXE percent bar plus a one-tick-per-function strip and the labelled mosaic inline, design plan in the brief (system font, existing palette, dark scheme, no JavaScript, deterministic). Depends on the badges-and-labels task (same file tools/progress.py). TDD.

Drive timestamps: prefix every `drive:` console line and each attempt's start and finish line printed by `reverseapoc drive` with local time [HH:MM:SS] through an injectable clock seam; exit codes and --json (exactly one document) unchanged. TDD.
